A note to everyone taking this class in the future: Do NOT, and I repeat, do NOT take this class in a semester where your classes are loaded and you have other difficult classes to focus on. You need to take this class in a semester where you have free time (although that is rare in Bilkent). Because this class, for some reason, has things called "midweeks" once every two weeks for the whole semester. You may think these midweeks are like small quizzes or something. Absolutely not. They are 2-hour exams that last from 6pm to 8pm. You take these every 2 weeks, and there is also a midterm and a final. So effectively, you'll be having a 2 hour exam every evening once every 2 week in a semester. You may think "okay then I guess these midweeks are easy and I can collect points easily". Again, WRONG. They can be very difficult. The exam averages were generally between 45-55, all semester. So you need to study A LOT, for each of them. Overall, this wouldn't be a problem if this was the only difficult class you were taking and you could devote most of your time to CS473. But if you have a stacked semester and other difficult classes, you're either going to not focus enough on this class and get low grades, or you're going to not focus enough on your other classes and get low grades from those. There's no third option, unless you're planning to study until morning each day all semester and go insane or something. Overall, this is a horrible system. I have no idea why they didn't just give homeworks or small quizzes or small projects like every other class in CS, instead of having these midweeks all semester, and I have also no idea how everyone agreed that this was a great idea, but here we are.
